mapper.select: select g.gen_id, g.rel_type, g.parent_lot_id, g.child_lot_id, g.qty, g.unit_cd, g.wo_proc_id, g.occurred_at, g.recorded_by, g.performed_by, g.reversal_of_id, g.reason, l.item_id, i.unit_cd as item_unit_cd, i.lot_ctrl_yn, w.plant_cd as proc_plant_cd, wp.node_id as proc_node_id from lot_genealogy g join lot_master l on l.lot_id = g.parent_lot_id join mst_item i on i.item_id = l.item_id left join prd_wo_proc wp on wp.wo_proc_id = g.wo_proc_id left join prd_wo w on w.wo_id = wp.wo_id where g.gen_id = #{genId}

select n.node_id from mst_equip_hier n where n.node_id = #{nodeId} union select p.node_id from mst_equip_hier n join mst_equip_hier p on p.node_id = n.parent_id where n.node_id = #{nodeId} and n.node_type = 'CELL' and p.node_type = 'LINE'

select coalesce(sum(s.qty), 0) from inv_stock s join wms_loc_attr a on a.node_id = s.node_id where s.plant_cd = #{plantCd} and s.item_id = #{itemId} and s.lot_id is not distinct from #{lotId}::bigint and s.stock_status = 'AVAILABLE' and s.qty > 0 and a.loc_usage = 'STAGING'

select s.stock_id, s.plant_cd, s.node_id, s.stock_status, s.qty from inv_stock s left join wms_loc_attr a on a.node_id = s.node_id where s.plant_cd = #{plantCd} and s.item_id = #{itemId} and s.lot_id is not distinct from #{lotId}::bigint and s.qty > 0 -- 가용 정의 하나(AvailSql) — 출하 대기(F1)·검사 용도(F-a)·폐기 칸은 투입하지 않는다 and -- 다른 라인을 보급하는 라인 옆 위치는 건드리지 않는다(그 라인의 자재) and not (a.loc_usage = 'LINESIDE' and a.feed_node_id is not null
and a.feed_node_id not in #{f} ) order by case when a.loc_usage = 'LINESIDE'
and a.feed_node_id in #{f}
and false
then 0 else 1 end, coalesce(a.pick_seq, 0), s.node_id

select s.stock_id, s.plant_cd, s.node_id, s.stock_status, s.qty from inv_stock s left join wms_loc_attr a on a.node_id = s.node_id where s.lot_id = #{lotId} and s.qty > 0 order by array_position(array[#{st}]::varchar[], s.stock_status::varchar), coalesce(a.pick_seq, 0), s.node_id

select s.stock_id, s.plant_cd, s.node_id, s.stock_status, s.qty from inv_stock s where s.stock_id in #{id} order by s.item_id, s.node_id, s.lot_id nulls first, s.stock_status -- InventoryService.CELL_ORDER 와 같은 순서(docs/30 11.6) for update

select exists (select 1 from inv_trx t where t.lot_id = #{lotId}) or exists (select 1 from inv_trx t where t.src_type = 'MAT_RECEIPT' and t.src_id = #{lotId}) or exists (select 1 from inv_trx t join prd_receipt r on r.receipt_id = t.src_id where t.src_type = 'PRD_RECEIPT' and r.lot_id = #{lotId})
select t.plant_cd from inv_trx t where t.lot_id = #{lotId} order by t.trx_id desc limit 1

select t.trx_id from inv_trx t where t.src_type = 'LOT_GEN' and t.src_id = #{genId} and t.reversal_of_id is null and t.trx_type in ('ISSUE_WO', 'CONV_OUT') and not exists (select 1 from inv_trx r where r.reversal_of_id = t.trx_id) order by t.trx_id
